## Problem

What concrete system problem needs to be solved?

## Proposed capability

Describe the smallest useful design.

## Contracts affected

## Validation plan

How should this be tested and what would count as evidence?

## Risks

Call out authority expansion, security, state migration, provider dependency, cost, or rollback concerns.
